The only places `str` is used is in tests. I'd prefer to change this to only accept Exceptions and update the tests. That adds more test coverage for this change, as well as preventing us from mistakenly passing in strings in the future.

You may find that means `test_invalid_input_error_includes_path_location` becomes redundant, it's fine to remove it if so.

Instead of modifying `context` here, could you modify it in `parsing.py` to be lowercase from the start?
https://github.com/wanxiankai/black/blob/3f8737446e0cce43d298066a5470e05ea994649e/src/black/parsing.py#L125
and again in the `TokenError` section
Similarly, could you include an initial newline in `details` in `parsing.py`? (And remove it from the `error_msg = ...` line)
Why use a class method instead of the constructor here?
Could this stay formatted as multiple lines?

Flake8 erorr:
```
src/black/parsing.py:28:5: B042 Exception class with `__init__` should pass all args to `super().__init__()` to work in edge cases of `pickle` and `copy.copy()`. It should also not take any kwargs.
```
I assume this is needed for pickling? Is it still needed after the Flake8 error is resolved? A comment to explain why this is needed could be helpful.
